launch.name: Work Orca
launch.summary: Orca on the default profile (%APPDATA%\orca), full screen 1: the one Orca on this machine, holding the work repos that `devenv orca apply` registers and the estate repos (rig) that `rig estate orca --apply` registers. On a re-run `window_pid_file` picks the window owned by the pid Orca records in orca-runtime.json.

launch.name: Work Triage
launch.summary: The rig triage queue (`rig triage`) in an ordinary Chrome window on the work profile, full screen 2, beside Orca: starts the rig web dashboard if it is not already answering, then opens its triage inbox. The triage window also gives the rest of the dashboard. `--new-window` makes Chrome open a window even though the Admin desktop's work-profile window already exists, and `window_title` matches every dashboard page (`Rig / Triage`, `Rig / Estate`) as well as the title it loads with (`Rig // Estate Management`), so a later restore finds the window again.
